metadata.description: Cohere embeddings (A/A+) merged with E5 Channel C results

paths.description: User recognized their constructed narrative as artificial and shattered their previous approach, finding the authentic core story
paths.reasoning: Clear T1 pattern: reflection (constructed narrative) + crisis (realization of artificiality) → shatter (broke down completely). Clear T2 pattern: in shattering, loss of coherence revealed the core (essential story). Domain matches Emotional (Heart) - transformation involved grief, relief, and emotional recognition of authenticity.

paths.description: User moved from elegant theoretical construction to embracing messy, authentic complexity in their storytelling
paths.reasoning: Clear T1 pattern: complexity (messy human experience) + simplicity (trying to create clear explanations) → elegance (constructed narrative). Clear T2 pattern: elegance + obscurity (frustrating ambiguity) → insight (realization that mystery IS the human experience). Domain matches Cognitive (Head) - transformation involved conceptual reframing and insight about truth.

paths.description: User shifted from detached documentation to embodied participation and presence in their creative process
paths.reasoning: Clear T1 pattern: insight (realization about authentic storytelling) + action (going back out with camera) → embodiment (participating and experiencing). Clear T2 pattern: embodiment + reflection (seeing the difference in footage) → manifestation (living footage that shows presence). Domain matches Cognitive (Head) - transformation involved moving from theoretical understanding to practical implementation and tangible results.

paths.description: User surrendered control over the creative timeline and embraced the organic transformation process
paths.reasoning: Clear T1 pattern: resistance (trying to manage/control) + release (letting waves complete) → surrender (not forcing timeline). Clear T2 pattern: surrender creates peace (trust in the process). Domain matches Emotional (Heart) - transformation involved emotional release and acceptance. Confidence is medium because while the surrender pattern is clear, the grace observation is implied rather than explicit.
